title: glue_strings
summary: Current Benilla parses Interface/GlueXML/GlueStrings.lua off the player's client data (KEY = "value" lines) for localized glue paragraphs, captions and modal strings, unfolding newline/tab/quote/backslash escapes and skipping code or malformed assignments. MSUI implements the same loader and graceful fallbacks; its create screen consumes the faction/race/ability/customization keys. MSUI additionally folds a handful of typographic punctuation marks to ASCII because its glue ImGui font lacks those glyphs, preserving readable text rather than replacement boxes.
